source.attribution: Berker Isen, Wind Turbine SCADA Dataset

timezone.note: Naive dataset timestamps must not be relabelled UTC.

licensing.note: A source URL does not establish redistribution rights.

theoretical_power_curve.value: KWh in source header; physical meaning not verified

artifact_identity.value: Compute SHA256 from supplied bytes at inventory time

feature_availability.known: Features use timestamp joins for t-10/20/30/60 and a mean of power at t,t-10,t-20,t-30; no later timestamp is required by the implemented formula.
feature_availability.unknown: When the SCADA value stamped t became available, its aggregation window and the actual forecast issuance/decision latency are not attested.
feature_availability.new_protocol_requirement: An explicit source/available-at/forecast-origin/decision contract is required; structural timestamp alignment does not certify physical availability.

models.current_inference_consistency: Previously checked; no inference is performed in this Stage 1 inventory.

additional_data_needed: A genuinely new, independently reserved SCADA outcome period or a new turbine/site with no research-team outcome inspection or controller/model selection exposure.
A signed or otherwise independently verifiable access/reservation record, exact source release identifier, acquisition dates and hashes, with the outcome custodian and release conditions identified.

Enough contiguous 10-minute observations for the preregistered exposure, at least 60 minutes of causal feature lookback, all six 10-60-minute targets and a target-level embargo before every scored decision.
Documented timezone/UTC offset and DST treatment, measurement-window semantics, timestamp synchronization, sensor/quality flags and measurement/forecast release latencies.
Confirmed units, preprocessing/missing-data rules and access/redistribution licence or explicit permission.

A separately eligible calibration/development period whose residual target times strictly precede every test decision and whose observation/residual availability times are no later than the decision, with model/controller identities and analysis frozen before outcome access.
